coordinates.locator: OSM way 131496014 "HERA Halle Nord" building centroid, 37.7 m from the north end of the OSM HERA tunnel ring
coordinates.note: Centroid of the HERA North Hall building footprint as traced in OpenStreetMap; the H1 detector stood inside this hall. It is a campus-grade point, shown as approximate, because an OpenStreetMap tracing is not a surveyed detector position. It replaces a ROR campus point 8.4 km away.

name: HERA North Hall (H1)
notes: No official DESY page or H1 detector paper consulted gives a coordinate for the North Hall; the point recorded is an OpenStreetMap tracing of the hall building (see the coordinate note).
Wikipedia's H1 article confirms the North Hall/H1 pairing: 'The HERA North Hall, where the H1 detector was located, is now used for the new ALPS experiment'.

summary.plain: The experimental hall on the HERA ring at DESY where the H1 detector recorded electron-proton collisions.
summary.technical: HERA North Hall, DESY campus, housing the H1 detector (1992-2007); now used for the ALPS experiment. The recorded point is the centroid of the hall building as traced in OpenStreetMap (about 50 m precision).
